title: Completion is the limit of a system with stable ranges and cofinal kernels
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $H$ an $A$-module, and $M:\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Mod}_A$ an inverse system [def-weil-inverse-system], whose index $n$ represents level $n+1$. Suppose $\rho_n:H\to M_n$ and $\theta_n:H/I^{n+1}H\to M_n$ are $A$-linear maps with $\theta_n\circ\mathrm{mkQ}=\rho_n$, and $\theta_n$ commute with all transitions. Suppose $c\in\mathbb N$ satisfies $\ker\rho_{n+c}\subseteq I^{n+1}H$ and $\operatorname{range}(M_{n+c}\to M_n)=\operatorname{range}\rho_n$ for every $n$. Then there is an $A$-linear isomorphism $e:H^\wedge\xrightarrow\sim\varprojlim M_n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] whose projection at $n$ is $\theta_n\circ\operatorname{eval}_{n+1}$. No Noetherian or finiteness assumption is required.

proof.text: Factoring through the quotient and transition compatibility give $(M_m\to M_n)\rho_m=\rho_n$. The maps $\theta_n\operatorname{eval}_{n+1}$ form a cone, hence induce a canonical linear map $\phi:H^\wedge\to\lim M$.

Injectivity: if $\phi(x)=0$, lift the component $x_{n+c+1}$ to $y\in H$. Its image under $\rho_{n+c}$ vanishes by the projection equation and factorization. The kernel bound puts $y$ in $I^{n+1}H\subseteq I^nH$. Compatibility therefore gives $x_n=0$ for every $n$, including $0$.

Surjectivity: for $z\in\lim M$, use stabilized ranges to choose $y_n\in H$ with $\rho_{n+c}(y_n)=z_{n+c}$. If $m\le n$, compatibility shows $y_n-y_m\in\ker\rho_{m+c}\subseteq I^{m+1}H\subseteq I^mH$. Thus $x_n=y_n\bmod I^nH$ is a compatible family defining an element of $H^\wedge$. At positive level $n+1$ its image under $\theta_n$ is $\rho_n(y_{n+1})=z_n$. Hence $\phi$ is surjective.
The bijective linear map induces a linear equivalence and a ModuleCat isomorphism. The projection equations are the limit-lift equations of the constructed cone.

lean.statement:
theorem adicCompletion_iso_of_stable_ranges {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (H : ModuleCat.{u} A) (M : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, H →ₗ[A] M.obj (op n))
    (θ : ∀ n : ℕ, (H ⧸ (I ^ (n + 1) • ⊤ : Submodule A H)) →ₗ[A]
      M.obj (op n))
    (hθ : ∀ n, (θ n).comp (Submodule.mkQ (I ^ (n + 1) • ⊤)) = ρ n)
    (htrans : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      (M.map (homOfLE h).op).hom.comp (θ m) =
        (θ n).comp (AdicCompletion.transitionMap I H (Nat.succ_le_succ h)))
    (c : ℕ)
    (hker : ∀ n : ℕ, LinearMap.ker (ρ (n + c)) ≤
      I ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule A H))
    (hrange : ∀ n : ℕ, Set.range (M.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n c)).op).hom =
      Set.range (ρ n)) :
    ∃ e : ModuleCat.of A (AdicCompletion I H) ≅ limit M,
      ∀ n : ℕ, e.hom ≫ limit.π M (op n) =
        ModuleCat.ofHom ((θ n).comp (AdicCompletion.eval I H (n + 1)))
